findings.title: Metric card primitive receives an incompatible icon shape
findings.detail: Metric variant="card" already wraps the supplied icon in an outer span and its shared .mg-metric grid expects the direct child icon to carry the grid-area styling. Passing a nested span with .mg-metric-icon makes that class non-direct, so the icon/body grid areas do not apply as intended; the Metric body wrapper also lacks the shared .mg-metric-body class. Both metric cards therefore have broken shared-primitive layout semantics.
